LESSON: MUSICAL INSTRUMENTS

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.3: Musical Instruments

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Musical Instruments. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: when playing c) demonstrate the skills of strumming string instruments?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify and name different and aurally string instruments used in played by music making bowing/striking/plucking/ playing of different string instruments

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify and name different and aurally string instruments used in played by music making bowing/striking/plucking/ playing of different string instruments
   In simple words: practise until you can identify and name different and aurally string instruments used in played by music making bowing/striking/plucking/ playing of different string instruments. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Musical Instruments using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Musical Instruments in the examples.
2. Explain Musical Instruments to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Musical Instruments.
4. Show that you can: identify and name different and aurally string instruments used in played by music making bowing/striking/plucking/ playing of different string instruments

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Musical Instruments using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Musical Instruments important for a Grade 3 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. In groups and individually, learners imitate music making, bowing/striking/plucking/ playing of different string instruments b) identify string instruments strumming? visually and aurally in
2. Learners are guided in proper maintenance, creativity, care and storage of string instruments e) use improvised string
3. Learners accompany familiar songs using instruments to accompany improvised string instruments such as mouth song for enjoyment, bows, ground bows and fiddles f) use improvised percussion,
4. Learners play improvised percussion, wind and wind and string instruments string instruments in an ensemble each trying in an ensemble for out different string instruments enjoyment,
5. Learners use digital devices to play and take g) use digital devices to record pictures/videos of the string instruments. and play virtual string

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify and name different and aurally string instruments used in played by music making bowing/striking/plucking/ playing of different string instruments

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
